component_median_caution: Per-component medians and median paired deltas are descriptive; their sums need not equal median whole-cycle differences and do not establish causes.
broader_correctness: Not run at this primary audit. If rejected, no broader/holdout/cumulative or extension qualifies; if qualifying, original broader/F32/GPU/continuation controls, wide-turn and fresh cumulative qualification remain mandatory.
scope_limits: Exact compressed CPU state plus exploitability/trajectory checks do not establish all possible raw F32 states
Source compatibility is not native proof; candidate-shared unit references do not replace immutable original broader controls
Full-cycle score includes runtime NVRTC/JIT and readback; excludes Cargo, fingerprinting/final destruction/browser/API/disk saving
Warm-driver-cache cohort; no experimentally controlled cold startup or statistical significance claim
Original E020 source remains retained baseline; no revival or additional timing extension authorized
reviewer_attempt_note: Narrow adaptation of successful E025 file-only audit after root terminal notification. Changed fixed IDs/pins, two owned showdown files, embedded changed-CUDA provenance and sealed D050/D051 prerequisite pins; authorization timestamp remains at. No proof rerun, helper import, compiler/native/GPU execution or outcome-triggered extension.

policy.guard: Median slowdown greater than3 percent AND at least2 of3 paired slowdowns greater than3 percent rejects adoption. No2 percent gain requirement on holdout. Failure to reach target by400 is inconclusive/failed qualification, not permission to retune.
policy.exactness: All6 complete CPU store files byte-identical; every non-timing field, root vector, stopping iteration and convergence trajectory exact.
policy.admission: Unchanged2GiB constructor budget,4GiB device free/30GiB total,16GiB host available,50GiB S reserve plus outputs; hands1128/1128,river max1081/1081,48river cards,node bound11691. No duplicate planning pass or budget rescue; layout/allocation unchanged.
policy.harness: Reuse exact R2 evaluator/resource/raw-codec provenance and numerical body; separately freeze E020/E026 bindings and per-arm unused Cargo targets before build. No R1 shared-target reuse.
policy.resource: Both arms reserve21808 dynamic shared bytes for up_show. E020 uses128 physical threads; E026 uses256 physical threads and128 logical scan lanes. D050 capacity/resource tradeoffs are metadata only; no occupancy-to-speed inference. Timed native work and frozen broad-range guard determine qualification.

holdout_freeze.entry_condition: Only primary qualification plus independent terminal review permits later separately frozen broader/holdout work. If this screen fails, no next qualification gate. No holdout result or acceptance claimed.

review_actions: Read-only source/evidence analysis and additive review artifacts; no builds/GPU/production/status mutation
